briefdescription.para: Allow subclasses to mutate the tag.

detaileddescription.para: Split Flags into SplitFlags, a vector of its components. Returns any remaining (unrecognized) bits.
A metadata node with a DWARF tag (i.e., a constant named DW_TAG_*, defined in llvm/BinaryFormat/Dwarf.h). Called DINode because it's potentially used for non-DWARF output.
